mentions.name: FDM 3D Print Profile Optimizer
mentions.description: This web app optimizes FDM 3D printing print profiles based on geometry, material, and hardware, aiming to reduce filament usage and waste, speed up print times, and improve print quality.
mentions.problem: Suboptimal print profiles lead to excess filament usage and waste, slow print times, and lower print quality.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building a web app that optimizes fdm 3d printing print profiles based on geometry, material, hardware etc.

evidence.value: I’m building a web app that optimizes fdm 3d printing print profiles based on geometry, material, hardware etc.
